about_the_game:
Weird Store is a fun FPV (First Person) store management shooter. Organize your shelves, restock products, and keep your customers happy. But stay alert — zombies, thieves, and aliens can attack your store anytime. Survive and grow your business!

What if zombies, thieves, or even aliens attacked your store every day… Could you really keep it running?

Fill your shelves, keep your customers happy, and grow your market. But don’t forget: you must stand strong against the monsters trying to take over your shop! A unique survival experience that combines management and defense is waiting for you.

Running a store has never been this strange!
Fill your shelves, manage your products, and keep your customers happy. But be careful — not everyone who walks in just wants to shop. Zombies, creatures, and even bandits are after your store.

Your job is to keep the business running while also defending it from every threat. Stock control, orders, and shelf management all mix together with action, survival, and strategy.

Use both your business sense and your reflexes — because in this world, profit and survival are in your hands.

content_descriptors.notes: This game does not contain graphic violence, sexual content, or drug/alcohol use. Players will experience a low-poly survival game focused on store management and defending against waves of monsters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 970 / AMD RX 470 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 / RX 5600 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
